units: pixels (image coords, x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale anywhere

camera.motion: static (phase-correlation shift of 3 background patches vs frame 0 <= 0.07 px in all frames; scene/camera_shift.json)

perspective_cues.notes: Table top seen obliquely from slightly above (camera somewhat above table-top height, looking slightly down). Front edge runs left->right getting lower (588 vs 540) i.e. the table is rotated, right front corner is nearer the camera. Horizon (eye level) is above the table top, roughly y ~ 330-400. Wall/room corner line near x ~ 820 above y 150.

ball.visible_frames: 0-48 (all); held in the thrower's right hand 0-22, released ~24 (23-26), free flight 26-48
